zh.title: 波音未說明是否還有下一輪裁員 工會：首批通知12月9日發出
zh.summary: 工程師工會 SPEEA 表示，波音民用飛機部門裁減 5% 人力的60天預告通知將於12月9日發出，收到通知者2月12日離職；資方未說明裁員人數，也未說明是否僅此一輪。
body: 美國航太專業工程人員協會（SPEEA）11月19日發布聲明指出，工會的聯合人力委員會當天與波音資深工程主管會面，主要討論日前宣布的裁員。工會表示，對於波音民用飛機部門（BCA）裁減 5% 人力的計畫，資方能提供的具體資訊很少，令工會失望。
依 SPEEA 說明，60天的裁員預告（WARN）通知將於12月9日發出，收到通知的員工將於2月12日離職。資方表示，尚未確定哪些人、多少人會收到通知，也未確定這是否為唯一一輪裁員。
工會轉述，波音民用飛機部門所有據點的人力都在檢討之列，但不一定每個據點都受影響；裁員不會全面等比例進行，而是針對即將結束或可以結束的工作項目，也不會開放自願離職或優退方案。波音防衛與太空部門及全球服務部門將取得被裁員工名單，協助媒合內部職缺。被問到裁員是否與近期的合約談判有關，資方回答「絕對不是」，並表示是提高產量的進度延後，導致部分計畫人力過剩。
SPEEA 另指出，波音規劃採「不到班」方式執行裁員：收到通知的員工仍可領60天薪資，但約一週後即不必到班。工會擔心這會切斷員工使用公司內部系統尋找其他職缺的管道，資方表示會把意見帶回民用飛機部門管理層。Simple Flying 引述路透報導，波音正設法把 737 MAX 月產量由42架提高到47架，原訂今年夏季達標，目前預計延至2027年初。

en.title: Boeing does not say whether more layoffs will follow; union says first notices go out December 9
en.summary: Engineering union SPEEA said 60-day notices for the 5% workforce cut at Boeing Commercial Airplanes will go out on December 9, with layoffs effective February 12. Boeing managers did not say how many people will be affected or whether this will be the only round.
body: The Society of Professional Engineering Employees in Aerospace (SPEEA) said in a November 19 statement that its Joint Workforce Committee met senior Boeing engineering managers that day, with the recently announced layoffs the main topic. The union said the managers had very little specific information about the planned 5% reduction of the Boeing Commercial Airplanes (BCA) workforce, which it called disappointing.

According to SPEEA, 60-day WARN notices will go out on December 9 and the people who receive them will be laid off on February 12. The managers said they had not yet determined who or how many people will receive notices, or whether this will be the only round of layoffs.

The union said employment at all BCA sites is under review, though layoffs will not necessarily affect every site. The cuts will be targeted at work statements that are ending or can be ended rather than applied across the board, and there will be no voluntary layoffs or buyouts. Boeing Defense and Space and Boeing Global Services will receive lists of affected workers so that skill teams can look for jobs for them. Asked whether the layoffs were retaliation for the recent contract talks, the managers said “absolutely not,” adding that delays in reaching higher production rates had left some programs overstaffed.

SPEEA also said Boeing is planning a “non-working reduction in force”: workers who receive notices will be paid for 60 days but told to stay home after about a week. The union objected that this would cut off access to Boeing's internal systems and make it harder to find other jobs within the company; the managers said they would take that feedback to BCA leadership. Simple Flying, citing Reuters, reported that Boeing is working to lift 737 MAX output from 42 to 47 jets a month, a rate it had expected to reach this past summer and now expects in early 2027.

facts.claim: 60-day WARN notices go out December 9; recipients will be laid off on February 12.
Boeing managers had not determined who or how many will receive notices or whether this is the only round.
All BCA sites are under review; layoffs are targeted, with no voluntary layoffs or buyouts; managers denied retaliation and cited delayed production rate increases.
Boeing is trying to raise 737 MAX output from 42 to 47 a month, now expected in early 2027, according to Reuters as cited by Simple Flying.
